title: Clinic Care Agreement
acknowledgment: I have read and agree to the Clinic Care Agreement.

clauses.heading: Authorization for care
clauses.text: I authorize Bethlehem Animal Clinic and its veterinary staff to examine and provide care reasonably necessary for my pet’s health, safety, and well-being. I understand that specific treatments, diagnostic procedures, or changes in the treatment plan may require further discussion and consent.

clauses.heading: Treatment risks
clauses.text: I understand that veterinary care may involve side effects, complications, or unexpected events despite appropriate care and precautions.

clauses.heading: Safety and loss
clauses.text: The clinic is not responsible for loss resulting from fire, theft, or escape when reasonable precautions have been taken.

clauses.heading: Visiting hours
clauses.text: If my pet is confined, I understand that pet visits are allowed during the clinic’s current operating hours: {operating_hours}.

clauses.heading: Laboratory, medication, and confinement costs
clauses.text: I am responsible for applicable laboratory, medication, and confinement costs and related clinic charges.

clauses.heading: Payment before discharge
clauses.text: I agree to settle applicable clinic charges before my pet is discharged or released, in accordance with Bethlehem’s billing procedures.

clauses.heading: Release and collection responsibilities
clauses.text: If I do not collect my pet within five days after notice for release, Bethlehem may consider my pet abandoned and act according to clinic policy. If my pet dies, I am responsible for collecting my pet’s body within 24 hours after death.

clauses.heading: Outstanding balances
clauses.text: Abandoning my pet does not remove my obligation to pay accumulated charges.
